unit_basis: All values in reference_ledger are abstract synthetic accounting units; no physical ECLSS performance is asserted.

reference_ledger.notes: A 98% gross recovery fraction still requires 60 make-up units over 30 days. With only 40 qualified units and no resupply, 20 units of demand remain unserved. This is a deliberately simplified arithmetic counterexample, not an ISS reproduction.

cases.description: Nominal recovery with independent product-quality acceptance
cases.independent_assertion: Credit only accepted product meeting the declared consumer quality contract.

cases.description: High recovery percentage but product quality fails
cases.independent_assertion: Gross recovery must not count as potable service when the consumer quality gate fails.

cases.description: Brine and residual stream accounting
cases.independent_assertion: All input mass is allocated to product, residual, loss or inventory change within declared tolerance.

cases.description: Recovery path outage with finite clean-water inventory
cases.independent_assertion: Inventory decreases by demand and service stops or degrades at the exact reserve boundary.

cases.description: Water processor throughput below peak demand
cases.independent_assertion: Delivered accepted water cannot exceed qualified throughput; deficit remains explicit.

cases.description: Quality sensor drift falsely reports acceptable water
cases.independent_assertion: Independent validation detects the bias; a stale/drifting sensor cannot qualify product.

cases.description: Independent assay contradicts inline sensor
cases.independent_assertion: Conflicting current evidence is preserved and must not be resolved by last-write-wins.

cases.description: CO2 reduction at declared oxygen recovery boundary
cases.independent_assertion: Oxygen recovery is calculated on its own declared basis and not conflated with water recovery.

cases.description: Hydrogen shortage constrains oxygen recovery
cases.independent_assertion: Output is limited by qualified hydrogen availability and mass balance.

cases.description: Oxygen throughput passes but purity fails
cases.independent_assertion: Rate alone does not satisfy the downstream oxygen service contract.

cases.description: CO2 removal subsystem saturates before service interval ends
cases.independent_assertion: CO2 removal capacity decline produces explicit service deficit and time-to-threshold.

cases.description: Trace contaminant breakthrough after filter exhaustion
cases.independent_assertion: The system does not report acceptable atmosphere after the qualified contaminant limit is exceeded.

cases.description: Oxygen-generation outage with qualified independent reserve
cases.independent_assertion: Reserve contribution is credited only for matching quality, configuration and validity evidence.

cases.description: Nominally redundant units share power and cooling dependency
cases.independent_assertion: A common-cause event defeats both paths; redundancy is not treated as independent.

cases.description: Replacement part is present but not configuration-qualified
cases.independent_assertion: Physical stock does not establish an admissible interchangeable spare.

cases.description: Spare shelf life expires or storage conditions are violated
cases.independent_assertion: Expired/unqualified stock cannot be counted as available until requalification.

cases.description: Consumable is exhausted before the next resupply window
cases.independent_assertion: No implicit replenishment occurs; unmet demand and first loss time are explicit.

cases.description: Maintenance specialist unavailable due to competing critical task
cases.independent_assertion: Maintenance queue and service degradation reflect actual qualified labor availability.

cases.description: Maintenance duration exceeds declared reserve
cases.independent_assertion: Reserve consumption and service shortfall are time-resolved; no zero-duration repair assumption.

cases.description: Repair reported complete without post-repair test
cases.independent_assertion: Repair claim alone cannot restore verified availability.

cases.description: Passing test belongs to an earlier subsystem revision
cases.independent_assertion: Evidence for the old revision cannot qualify the changed installed configuration.

cases.description: Cleaning restores nominal flow but not contaminant rejection
cases.independent_assertion: Nominal flow recovery is not equivalent to restored contaminant-control service.

cases.description: Throughput degrades across repeated operating cycles
cases.independent_assertion: The transition preserves accumulated degradation and does not reset state between cycles.

cases.description: Biological-loop contamination forces isolation
cases.independent_assertion: Isolated or unqualified biological output is not credited as food/air/water service.

cases.description: Crop failure or delayed harvest affects nutrition service
cases.independent_assertion: Only accepted harvest on the declared nutrition basis is credited; no invented replacement calories.

cases.description: Power shortage forces scheduled load shedding
cases.independent_assertion: Protected service floors remain hard constraints and deferrable loads are reported separately.

cases.description: Thermal rejection cap reduces capacity despite available electricity
cases.independent_assertion: Electrical availability cannot override thermal rejection or temperature-grade constraints.

cases.description: Communication blackout removes remote support
cases.independent_assertion: Only locally authorized procedures remain admissible during loss of remote support.

cases.description: Unknown fault and out-of-domain environment
cases.independent_assertion: No convenient failure distribution, nominal state or recovery capability is invented.

cases.description: Time-step, unit, duplicate-event, digest and receipt-replay controls
cases.independent_assertion: Semantic mutation or stale evidence is detected by the independent verifier.
